# Essam Gouda — egouda.xyz

Personal website and blog by Essam Gouda — software engineer, AI/ML practitioner.

## Blog

Blog posts are available as structured JSON for programmatic access.

- Post listing (metadata): https://egouda.xyz/api/blog
- Individual post (full markdown): https://egouda.xyz/api/blog/{slug}
- Human-readable blog: https://egouda.xyz/blog
